description: Artificial Scenario Generator for the Impact Study of Electric Vehicle Charging on the Distribution Grid is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Komal Khan, Islam El-Sayed. An efficient artificial scenerio generator for EV load simulation modeling has been developed acquiring probabilistic method for characterizing the stochastic nature of EVs and generate the schedule of EVs charging to ultimately achieve the EV load profile for impact study of EVs on distribution network. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
